purpose: 첨부한 flex 화면 스타일을 참고해 명문가의 HTML 제작 기준으로 사용할 이미지 시안

references.role: 사용자 첨부 스타일 참고: 옅은 윤곽선과 여백이 있는 업무 타일
사용자 첨부 스타일 참고: 넓은 명부 행과 가는 구분선
사용자 첨부 스타일 참고: 사이드바, 목록, 상세의 평평한 분할

designRules.hierarchy: 절제된 제목, 짧은 문구, 넓은 여백, 일관된 정렬
designRules.navigation: 회색 메뉴 선택 표시와 짧은 검정 탭 밑줄
designRules.borders: 가는 회색 구분선; 업무 바로가기 타일에만 옅은 윤곽선
designRules.accent: 출처 링크에만 작은 파란색 강조, 필요한 주요 버튼은 짙은 회색
designRules.implementationNote: 실제 HTML에서는 공통 사이드바 폭과 아이콘을 통일하고 PRD의 반응형·큰 글자·터치 영역 기준을 적용한다.

notes: PNG 이미지 시안이며 서비스 구현·API 호출·제품 검증 완료를 나타내지 않는다.
생성 이미지의 구성과 한국어를 눈으로 확인했으며, 명부의 열 제목과 임의의 생년 표기는 별도 이미지 편집 호출로 수정했다.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one finished Korean desktop application UI image. Flat front-on screenshot, landscape 16:10, around 1600x1000 pixels, edge-to-edge, no device frame or browser chrome. Product name "명문가", a Korean clan administration service.

The three attached images are STRICT VISUAL STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. Image 1 demonstrates flex's extremely quiet outlined action grid; image 2 its spacious member rows; image 3 its bare master-detail split. Match the attached flex screenshots' visual grammar faithfully: a pale neutral-gray 240px sidebar, pure white content canvas, fine #eeeeee rules, dark-gray clean Korean sans serif type, restrained hierarchy, generous continuous whitespace. Selected sidebar item is pale NEUTRAL gray with dark text. White outline buttons. Active tabs have a short dark underline. Only tiny functional accents in muted blue. Readable, ordinary clean Korean SaaS typography, modest 28–30px main titles and 14–16px body in desktop proportions. Precise spacing, not decorative. The reference's grayscale restraint is the main requirement. White is the dominant color; do not fill every open area.

Use the same understated app shell in all screens: compact plain "명문가" text next to a small neutral document glyph, not an ornate tree logo; workspace dropdown "임영대군파 종중"; sidebar utility items "검색", "알림", "내 프로필"; divider; product navigation "종중 홈", "설립 준비", "종원 명부", "총회·동의", "회의와 기록", "재산·회계", "법률·문제 확인". Bottom user text "시연 관리자" and small gear icon for settings. Small quiet gray text "예시 데이터" in a top-right corner. No real user identity, no actual authentication claim. All record values are examples.

Do NOT reproduce red privacy rectangles, black screenshot censor bars, other-company logos, real people, reference names, or irrelevant HR vacation features. No saturated green branding, no large colored bands, no hero banners, no financial KPIs, no progress charts, no shadows, no gradients, no dashboard bento, no cards nested inside cards, no decorative illustrations, no extra floating controls, no heavy borders or pill badges. The user rejected a busy dashboard: it must be as spare, flat and quietly organized as the supplied flex screens.

SCREEN: 종중 홈. Use Image 1 as the strongest layout reference.
Sidebar "종중 홈" is selected. Main content begins with a simple large title "종중 홈" at left, no extra global top search/profile bar. Under it modest tabs "오늘", "전체 업무", active "오늘" with dark underline, then a thin full-width divider.

At around y=180, section heading "확인할 일". Just THREE plain horizontal rows, full width, separated by faint rules, not enclosed in boxes. Left aligned short task title; secondary small gray provenance below; a simple gray-text state at the far right:
"회의록 금액 확인" / "총회 준비 회의 · v0.3" / "검토 필요"
"총회 소집 안내 검토" / "10월 정기총회 · 안내문 v0.3" / "초안"
"미가입 종원 안내" / "명부에 등록된 미가입자 12명" / "전화 안내 대기".
A quiet monochrome chevron at each row's right. No dates and numbers that pretend to be real operational metrics.

Then at around y=455 heading "종중 업무" and a SIMPLE SIX-ITEM outline grid, three columns by two rows. Like the supplied flex vacation tiles: spacious white interiors, extremely fine light-gray outline, around 12px corner radius, no shadow, a small light-gray functional icon top left; short dark title and one muted description lower left. Each tile is around 175px tall with a lot of blank space:
"설립 준비" — "준비 서류와 상담 자료"
"종원 명부" — "연락처와 가입 상태"
"총회·동의" — "안건과 응답 확인"
"회의와 기록" — "녹음 원문과 회의록"
"재산·회계" — "토지와 거래 자료"
"법률·문제 확인" — "근거와 상담 준비".
Do not add decorative counts, status banners, data charts or extra cards. Keep an uncluttered bottom margin. Exactly one simple UI screen, no multiple mockups, no side-by-side comparison board. Correct, legible Korean.

Below the list leave substantial untouched white space. Minimal flat composition, the same visual weight, gutters and understated icons as the supplied flex member page. Correct readable Korean, no red censor rectangles, no additional analytics or instruction panels.
images.finalEditPrompt:
Use case: text-localization. Edit the supplied Korean UI mockup. Make ONLY TWO small text corrections; keep the grayscale flex-like visual style, complete sidebar, all positions, row heights, white space, fonts, thin lines, avatars, names, values, selected tabs, and the whole layout unchanged.

1. Correct the list's column headings to label all FIVE existing columns accurately. From left to right:
"종원" above names,
"직책" above the existing values 총무/회장/종원/검토 담당,
"권한" above the existing values 관리자/일반 종원/검토자,
"가입 상태" above 가입 완료/미가입,
"안내" above 안내 완료/전화 안내 대기/전화 안내 완료/연락 확인 필요.
Use the same tiny quiet gray text, alignment and existing header baseline. Do not move the five columns or add boxes.

2. Under each of the six member names, replace the entire gray line containing a clan name and invented birth year with the simple exact text "시연 종원". Same font size, baseline and pale gray color. There must be no birth years or ages anywhere.

Everything else remains identical, especially the quiet minimalist whitespace and white/gray style. This is a fictional clan roster design reference, not actual personal data. Keep the small "예시 데이터" mark. No decorative elements and no new text beyond these edits. Output the complete original landscape screen.
